title: Classify all minimum E7 frame relations in characteristic zero
body:
Every characteristic-zero E7 frame relation with minimum support twelve belongs to one of **two quadratic types**: **630 rank-six supports** and **1,008 rank-two supports**. Every support has exactly one scalar family of relations. This completes the equality question in Nick Petalas's [PR #5238](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5238). It gives a complete list of sparse obstructions at the decoder-incidence boundary. **No new complete kappa is claimed.**

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/700efb538a3d919409c9506d117846b7895b02ea/research/e7-minimum-support-classification/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/700efb538a3d919409c9506d117846b7895b02ea/research/e7-minimum-support-classification/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/700efb538a3d919409c9506d117846b7895b02ea/research/e7-minimum-support-classification/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/700efb538a3d919409c9506d117846b7895b02ea/research/e7-minimum-support-classification/SOURCES.json) and [validation record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/700efb538a3d919409c9506d117846b7895b02ea/research/e7-minimum-support-classification/VALIDATION.md) are pinned to `700efb538a3d919409c9506d117846b7895b02ea`. The result covers all fields of characteristic zero and every E8 root slice. It classifies all frame-sum relations of support twelve, including inputs not supplied as quadratics. The separate arbitrary-deletion extension in the [released handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1502#discussioncomment-19145642) remains open.

The checker enumerates all **134,217,727** nonzero binary frame-code words and finds **1,638** minimum supports. Exact root reflections split these into the two stated orbits. Both representatives have six positive and six negative values. Exact rational rank eleven proves a unique lift on each twelve-line support. The written proof uses rational minors to extend the result to arbitrary characteristic zero. A diagonal ansatz alone misses the second type.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/e7-minimum-support-classification
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/e7-minimum-support-classification
```

Expected: `PASS_E7_MINIMUM_SUPPORT_CLASSIFICATION`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Registered normal and optimized checks pass, including all 63 root reflections on all 135 frames, exact quadratic ranks, ambient transport, 24 coordinate-omission controls and four corruption controls. Committed-byte and export checks pass. The scientific files also pass a read-only Git-free optimized replay with empty PATH; every exported byte is unchanged. Actual corruption of the retained source is rejected before execution.

Canonical base and final refresh: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`, priority revision 7. The authenticated selected metadata remains at conditional kappa 0.00310045, limited by the main-transform row. Only this package is added. The [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1502#discussioncomment-19188245) and final complete metadata search found no competing equality claim. Full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout; immediate ancestry and exact source bytes were checked.

Credit Nick Petalas for the support bound, frame-code geometry and injectivity proof, retained in the [source note](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/700efb538a3d919409c9506d117846b7895b02ea/research/e7-minimum-support-classification/vendor/PR5238.md). Credit JoyboyBrian for the handoff and the source note's Josie Elliston, Andrey Mas, Aaron Wang, Brett Halligan, themilkman216 and DreamingOfClouds lineage. New equality census, orbit classification, characteristic-zero argument, proof and checks: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

No arbitrary-deletion extension, new decoder floor, physical supplier, native/outer admission, selected cold replay, full historical suite, Lean, Docker, independent human review or formal proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. CI is pending at publication. The next useful step is the missing extension lemma or a literal comparison of the two types with the next deletion boundary; neither is reserved here.
